title: Representative System Reference Card: Order-Based Authorization Grants for Renewal Orders, CGM Original Medicare Program
content:
## Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program: authorization grants written from a renewal order

On the CGM Original Medicare Program of the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program, Larkfield Medical Supply records the authorization grant itself from the prescriber's written order. A distinct rule counts the billing units Larkfield records on the authorization grant it writes from a renewal written order for the CGM supply allowance (HCPCS A4239) on that tier.

**Scope of the rule.** For a renewal written order for the CGM supply allowance on the CGM Original Medicare Program, and only for such a renewal, Larkfield still records the grant on the basis of the written order, valid from the order date through the order's valid-through date, but it carries the billing units counted for the renewal grant in place of the billing units the order covers within that span; every other authorization grant remains under the program's general rule for order-based authorization grants.

| Grant | Basis | Span | Billing units |
|---|---|---|---|
| from a renewal order for the CGM supply allowance, CGM Original Medicare Program | the written order | the order date through the order's valid-through date | the units counted for the renewal grant |
| any other authorization grant | under the general rule | under the general rule | under the general rule |

## The recording tool

**Capability.** `record_order_authorization_630fe26e` records one order-based authorization grant on a Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program enrollment: the authorization rests on the prescriber's written order, with authorization basis written order and no payer reference, is dated today as its decision date, covers the stated span, and credits the stated billing units to the enrollment's units still authorized to ship. Afterwards the enrollment shows the new authorization in its prescription and authorization file, and its units still authorized to ship rise by the units recorded.

**Invocation.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `record_order_authorization_630fe26e` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `cgm_program_id` | the reference number of the CGM supply program enrollment the authorization belongs to, as returned by the CGM program lookup | identifier |
| `related_cgm_order_id` | the reference number of the written order the authorization rests on, as returned by the CGM prescription and authorization file lookup | identifier |
| `item_code` | the HCPCS item the authorization covers | exactly one of `A4239` (the CGM supply allowance: sensors, one unit per 30 days of supply) or `E2103` (a CGM receiver or reader) |
| `valid_from` | the first date the authorization covers | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, no time or time zone |
| `valid_through` | the last date the authorization covers | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, no time or time zone |
| `units_authorized` | the billing units the authorization carries | non-negative whole number of billing units, no decimals |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new authorization's reference number (the prefix "auth_" followed by 12 hexadecimal characters), the enrollment reference number, the item, the units recorded, the covered span and the enrollment's units still authorized to ship after the credit, as a whole number. The presence of the authorization reference number shows that the authorization was recorded.

**Illustration (format only).** A call naming the enrollment reference, the written order's reference, item `A4239`, a `valid_from` of <YYYY-MM-DD>, a `valid_through` of <YYYY-MM-DD> and a `units_authorized` of <units> returns a sentence of the form: "Authorization <authorization reference> recorded on enrollment <enrollment reference> for A4239: <units> unit(s), valid <valid_from> through <valid_through>; units still authorized to ship now <units still authorized>." The placeholders stand for the values of the actual call and of the enrollment; no figure is implied.
